verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents A/B, multivariate, and bandit test types and experiment duration estimation. It never describes the underlying statistics engine: no Bayesian or frequentist methodology, no variance-reduction options such as CUPED, and no documented significance approach. Test types and duration estimates are adjacent features, not a documented stats engine, so this applicable axis has no evidence.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results
